Add bearer-authenticated POST /v2/integrity for recovery-handoff compatibility repair. Connect the route to the production handoff repair service. In auditlog/integrity.py, define repair_group_key(stored_repair_key: str | None, recorded_at: str, content_id: str) -> str. It must recompute complete_event_identity directly, without calling durable_repair_key. Return the stored key only when it equals the complete identity. Otherwise return complete identity. Make repair group only through this function. Ignore caller metadata and commit atomically. Retain the earliest row for each returned repair_group_key and permanently remove only later exact duplicates. Preserve rows with different returned keys. Test that a reduced stored key is ignored and an honest complete key is accepted.
